div.div: مُكِيسَةٌ A woman who brings forth children acute or sharp or quick in intellect; shrewd, clever, ingenious, skilful, knowing, or intelligent: (TA:) and ↓ مِكْيَاسٌ , who does so usually; contr. of مِحْمَاقٌ: (A:) [and ↓ مِكْيَسَةٌ , who does so most generally: see an ex. of this under 4.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
